notes.title: Full Release & New DLC!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Today is a big day for us.

Before we begin, we just want to express our appreciation to everyone who has supported our game. Thanks to all of your help and suggestions, the game has improved a awful lot compared to our original version.  

We definitely chose a complicated genre for our studio's first game, and with little actual experience we instead relied on pure passion to get us through development! There were two main features that we had hoped to add into the game, only to later discover that the base (coding) design would not allow us to integrate them. The first of these was the integration of a fully flowing story, and the second was Workshop support. We know that both of these features were greatly anticipated by those who have already devoted many hours to the game, and we are very sorry to have been unable to implement them. The story of Eagarlnia actually already includes close to 300k words, many of which are sprinkled throughout the story elements while you are choosing your country, or included with the heroes in the collection album. As for additional background story and world design, we will include this in future community posts for those who are interested in the lore.

We released more than 10 version updates throughout the entire Early Access period. On top of optimizations to hundreds of details, these updates included the addition of the faction camps system, city defense battle system, 30+ new special heroes, 100+ types of troops, dozens of skill designs, as well as the Ayla Scroll (the game editor which allows you to take full control). In this update, we've added a new skill tree system for all forces to make the game even more complete. (Oh, and don't forget to check out the new forces in the full release version too! )

Even though the game has now graduated to full release, we've decided not to raise the price as originally planned. Instead, we have developed an optional DLC for players who want to experience more of the story. However, we feel the full release version offers the complete Eagarlnia gaming experience, with or without the DLC, so we hope players who decide not to purchase the new content don't feel like they're missing out. 
Speaking of the DLC, our original plan was to launch two packs separately at $3.99 each. However, due to some last minute technical issues involving save files, we decided to combine these packs and instead offer them as one DLC with all content included, priced at $5.99. We hope you will like the design of our new eastern and elvish forces. 

Details of the full release content are included in our previous post, so please check that out for a more in- depth breakdown:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1116880/view/3105801764904722988

Lastly, we want to thank you again for all of your continued support. We'll still be here listening to all of your feedback, and please don't hesitate to contact us through Discord or email if you encountered any issues in the game.

Thank you ❤️

notes.title: The Heroic Legend of Eagarlnia leaves Early Access with a massive content update
notes.notes:
Greetings to all of our players. 

Several months ago we promised everyone a major game update, and we totally understand if some of you were starting to lose hope that it would ever materialize. We're very sorry to have kept you all waiting for so long. In truth, we had our heads down and were continually working on fixing bugs and creating additional content!

Following more than two months of testing and optimization, we are delighted to finally release our major update to players. In addition, with this new round of content and bug fixes, The Heroic Legend of Eagarlnia is now ready to leave Early Access. Don't worry, the price of the game will remain the same. Moreover, we will continue to listen to player feedback and suggestions in order to further optimize the game. 
Now, let's dive into the specifics of our major update:

1. The technology tree system
We've removed the original faction characteristics and instead designed an exclusive technology tree for each faction. This technology tree includes buffs and special effects for actions such as troops, investment, public sentiment, fortification, and destruction, as well as the unlocking of special equipment for advanced arms. Players can use skill points to unlock the technology tree by advancing rounds, investing in city size, and completing heroic missions. Meanwhile, we've also designed a technology tree logic for AI.

2. Value adjustment
In order to avoid scenarios where all heroes end up being overly similar, we have re-adjusted the strength of each hero to make them more unique and to give them a more distinct role. We've also made numerical adjustments to the soldiers of the imperial forces.

3. Battle changes
Player feedback shows that the battles can be cluttered and difficult to control. To address this, we've moved from 6V6 battles to 5V5 battles. In addition, we've reduced the number of soldiers carried by the hero from 5 per level to 4 per level, further reducing the potential for chaos during a battle.

4. New content and DLC
We have added a new force composed of wild heroes, the "Western Liberty Army", as well as 10 new cities, 24 new equipment items, 12 passive skills, 10 active skills, and 18 effects. 
We have also added two new DLCs, which together include 4 new factions, 32 new heroes, 52 new troop types, and 13 new cities. Further details of each DLC will be introduced within the game.

5. Other optimizations
We have removed many heroes with duplicate faces, while also creating better quality portraits. This should reduce instances of players recruiting a large number of similar heroes. We have also made adjustments to loading screens, which will now show the stories and backgrounds of the powers and heroes.

Finally, we would like to take this opportunity to express our sincere appreciation to our players for all the support and patience they have shown throughout the past year. We are honored and thankful that you enjoy playing our game! We will keep optimizing The Heroic Legend of Eagarlnia as we strive to produce even better new experiences for everyone to enjoy!!!

notes.title: 10.21 Major Update Alert
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have another major update released today, details below:

1. In "easy" game difficulty, we adjusted the limit to hero maintenance fee in order to allow for the collection of more heroes. 

2. We have made AI more aggressive in attacks in "hard" game difficulty, which makes growth faster but will also experience heavier economic pressure, this was made in mind of those who like more challenge.

3. Added a categorization filter for heroes based on their equipment/gear type. 

4. Only one pop up character dialogue when commanding multiple heroes to "search" missions.

5. When a new hero is found, you can choose to "accept" or "deny" that hero from joining your faction, this also avoids the repeated action of "exiling" a hero you do not want.

6. Adding the setting option of turning on or off the skill animation during battle, you can now choose to turn it on or off to avoid the zooming in and out when skills are released.

7. Adjusted the maintenance levels to have more reasonable fees.

8. Fixed calculation errors for negotiation system, which was originally causing the cost of agreements to be too low. Also fixed the system error occurring in city trading (i.e. not allowing you to trade off your last city).

9. AI optimization, making AI's actions more reasonable and economy behavior deviate less from normal.

10. Strengthened the Shadow Undead faction, added a "golden" material for the Shadow Undead leader's main weapon.

Thanks for reading!
*Also watch our notice on our store page!*

notes.title: 2020 Last Quarter + 2021 Update Plans
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
It’s been 5 full days since our early access release - we want to say a BIG “Thank you” to all those who not only supported us but gave us some valuable takeaways that would help us improve the game. We want to reassure everyone that we took the time to go through each and every feedback. The following is a big picture roadmap on our plan to improve the existing build. 
If you haven’t already joined our Discord, we strongly encourage you to do so - for discussions, manuals/guides on beating level difficulties, and reporting future bugs and feedback. 
We welcome more ideas and feedback, please see a draft our roadmap:

Easier things to solve:
1. Add notification to remind you certain treaties will expire/come close to due date
2. Optimize the “Lobby” mechanism
3. Adjustments to city tax rates
4. Add more functionalities to “Unified Direct” to allow more things to be done at once
5. New faction strengths: Cit wall, city prosperity, soldier and commander auto recover ratio
6. Expand on alliance: for example, allowing for alliance military to support you in battle
7. New UI change

Slightly harder things:
1. Battle optimization: Adding concepts of geography, adding player command flexibility etc.
2. Secret realms: Adding secret realm battles and random selection of items
3. Faction strengths: Plunders and sacrifices after battle wins
4. Soldier type mechanisms: Soldiers categorized by factions, adding characteristics based on faction and change of conditions to unlock different soldier types

Hardest things:
1. Faction mastery tree system 
2. Steam Workshop 
3. Customizable/Self-defined factions

Extra ideas we’re pondering:
1. Redesign the faction “Shadow Undead” including its design and faction strengths
2. “Collapse” level from interrogation 
3. DLCs 

We’re grateful for this support so far and for understanding we’re an indie development team of 4. Despite the bigger pillars we’ll be working on and brainstorming ideas to smoothen out the edges, we will still be making bug fixes and updates regularly and keeping everyone posted. 
Our sincerest gratitude and we look forward to having more fun with you guys! Take care for now.

Hongshou
